name: Phantom Bells
description: The echo of diabolic bells reverberates with a bone-shaking clamor.
disable: DC 27 Religion (expert) to break the curse with recitations against the power of Hell (2 actions), or DC 22 Performance (expert) to Perform an opposing composition
reset: The bells cease ringing if there are no living creatures within 30 feet.
routine: (1 action) The bells toll, dealing 4d6 Sonic Damage damage to each living creature within 30 feet (Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

generalAbilities.name: Distant Ringing
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 30 feet.

Effect Sounds of creaking metal fill the area as the phantom bells begin to swing and the haunt rolls initiative.
